key.name: overlay-key
key.summary: Modifier to use for extended window management operations
key.description:
This key will initiate the “overlay”, which is a combination window overview and application launching system. The default is intended to be the “Windows key” on PC hardware.
It’s expected that this binding either the default or set to the empty string.

key.name: attach-modal-dialogs
key.description: When true, instead of having independent titlebars, modal dialogs appear attached to the titlebar of the parent window and are moved together with the parent window.

key.name: edge-tiling
key.summary: Enable edge tiling when dropping windows on screen edges
key.description: If enabled, dropping windows on vertical screen edges maximizes them vertically and resizes them horizontally to cover half of the available area. Dropping windows on the top screen edge maximizes them completely.

key.name: window-shadow
key.description: If enabled, a black shadow will appear at the edge of the window.

key.name: window-border
key.description: If enabled, the edge of the window is wrapped with a gray border, which is clearly delimited from the other window.

key.name: window-decoration-can-modify
key.description: Determines whether the window decoration can be modified,such as titlebar opacity, border shadow.

key.name: window-radius
key.description: If enabled, the upper left corner and upper right corner of the window changed from square to arc.

key.name: titlebar-opacity
key.description: Transparency

key.name: dynamic-workspaces
key.description: Determines whether workspaces are managed dynamically or whether there’s a static number of workspaces (determined by the num-workspaces key in org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences).

key.name: workspaces-only-on-primary
key.description: Determines whether workspace switching should happen for windows on all monitors or only for windows on the primary monitor.

key.name: no-tab-popup
key.description: Determines whether the use of popup and highlight frame should be disabled for window cycling.

key.name: focus-change-on-pointer-rest
key.summary: Delay focus changes until the pointer stops moving
key.description: If set to true, and the focus mode is either “sloppy” or “mouse” then the focus will not be changed immediately when entering a window, but only after the pointer stops moving.

key.name: draggable-border-width
key.description: The amount of total draggable borders. If the theme’s visible borders are not enough, invisible borders will be added to meet this value.

key.name: auto-maximize
key.summary: Auto maximize nearly monitor sized windows
key.description: If enabled, new windows that are initially the size of the monitor automatically get maximized.

key.name: center-new-windows
key.summary: Place new windows in the center
key.description: When true, the new windows will always be put in the center of the active screen of the monitor.

key.name: experimental-features
key.description:
To enable experimental features, add the feature keyword to the list. Whether the feature requires restarting the compositor depends on the given feature. Any experimental feature is not required to still be available, or configurable. Don’t expect adding anything in this setting to be future proof.
Currently possible keywords:
• “scale-monitor-framebuffer” — makes mutter default to layout logical monitors in a logical pixel coordinate space, while scaling monitor framebuffers instead of window content, to manage HiDPI monitors. Does not require a restart. • “rt-scheduler” — makes mutter request a low priority real-time scheduling. The executable or user must have CAP_SYS_NICE. Requires a restart. • “autostart-xwayland” — initializes Xwayland lazily if there are X11 clients. Requires restart. • “x11-randr-fractional-scaling” — enable fractional scaling under X11 using xrandr scaling. It might reduce performances. Does not require a restart.

key.name: fractional-scaling-factor
key.summary: Set the default fractional scaling factor of x11 xrandr
key.description: This key will be used under the key 'experimental-features' is enabled 'x11-randr-fractional-scaling'. Support value's format: 0, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, ..., step is 0.25. If this value is '0', mutter will calculate a scale factor automatically by the monitor resolution.

key.name: expected-monitors-scale
key.summary: Cache the expected monitors scaling factor, which is used for mutter startup next time.
key.description: This key will be used in mutter init only, set the monitors scale and save to monitors.xml. For example like ['HDMI-1:1.5', 'HDMI-2:1.25', '*:1.25', '@HDMI-1:1.5', '@HDMI-2:1.25'], monitors layout: 'HDMI-1:1.5', 'HDMI-2:1.25' is linear, '*:1.25' is mirror, '@HDMI-1:1.5', '@HDMI-2:1.25' is single. 'HDMI-1' is connector name, '1.5' is scaling factor.

key.name: locate-pointer-key
key.summary: Modifier to use to locate the pointer
key.description: This key will initiate the “locate pointer” action.

key.name: check-alive-timeout
key.description: Number of milliseconds a client has to respond to a ping request in order to not be detected as frozen. Using 0 will disable the alive check completely.

key.name: join-multi-monitors
key.description: Join multiple monitors and one

key.name: join-multi-monitors-enable
key.description: Enabel join multiple monitors to one

key.name: power-save-mode-off-enable
key.description: property PowerSaveMode value 'off' whether enable, default enable
